title: Project Hero Stage: Media
summary: Media stage of the project hero (window, square, video).
description: The media stage of project_hero: a gallery image in a window (the project name in its bar), a square card (another square image, else the logo) and a card with the first video that plays in the popup; every piece sways in a slow loop. Links to the gallery section. Rendered by project_hero; frame colors, the stage base and the tag come from it.
